name: @dreamteamer/docker-workspaces
description: dt-docker — run a dreamteamer workspace as a local Docker container, and move its workspaces between containers as one encrypted file.

dreamteamer.title: Docker workspaces
dreamteamer.description: Workspaces as local Docker containers. Installed globally, `dt-docker` needs no workspace: it checks Docker, pulls a template image, creates and starts a container with a code-server editor at a loopback URL over three named volumes, and exports or imports a container's workspaces as one encrypted file. Installed in a workspace as well, it adds the `running-workspaces-in-containers` skill, so the coding agent there knows the verbs.
